mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NUTRITION_ANALYSIS (video_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, video_id AS videoId, status, total_calories AS totalCalories, total_carbs AS totalCarbs, total_protein AS totalProtein, total_fat AS totalFat, foods_json AS foodsJson, error_message AS errorMessage, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM NUTRITION_ANALYSIS WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.update: UPDATE NUTRITION_ANALYSIS SET status = #{status}, total_calories = #{totalCalories}, total_carbs = #{totalCarbs}, total_protein = #{totalProtein}, total_fat = #{totalFat}, foods_json = #{foodsJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recognized_food_item (nutrition_analysis_id, food_name, calories, carbs, protein, fat) VALUES (#{nutritionAnalysisId}, #{foodName}, #{calories}, #{carbs}, #{protein}, #{fat})
mapper.select: SELECT id, nutrition_analysis_id AS nutritionAnalysisId, food_name AS foodName, calories, carbs, protein, fat FROM recognized_food_item WHERE nutrition_analysis_id = #{nutritionAnalysisId} ORDER BY id
